---
title: "Research Metrics"
description: "Citation metrics from Google Scholar."
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r setup}
source("_common.R")
library(ggplot2)

meta <- load_meta()
profile <- readr::read_csv(here::here("content", "scholar_profile.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
history <- readr::read_csv(here::here("content", "scholar_citation_history.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
scholar_pubs <- readr::read_csv(here::here("content", "scholar_pubs.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(cites))
```

<center>
`r icon_link(icon = "ai ai-google-scholar", text = "View on Google Scholar", url = meta$scholar_url)`
</center>

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat(glue::glue(
  '<div class="stat-card-row">',
  '<div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-value">{profile$total_cites}</div><div class="stat-label">Total Citations</div></div>',
  '<div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-value">{profile$h_index}</div><div class="stat-label">h-index</div></div>',
  '<div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-value">{profile$i10_index}</div><div class="stat-label">i10-index</div></div>',
  '</div>'
))
```

## Citations by Year

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
ggplot(history, aes(x = year, y = cites)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2E6E8E") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Citations") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## Most-Cited Papers

```{r}
top <- head(scholar_pubs, 15)
knitr::kable(
  top[, c("title", "journal", "year", "cites")],
  col.names = c("Title", "Journal", "Year", "Citations")
)
```

<aside>Data last refreshed `r format(as.Date(profile$fetched_at), "%B %d, %Y")`. Google Scholar rate-limits automated requests, so these numbers are cached rather than live — run `refresh_scholar_data.R` to update them.</aside>
